blocks.task_summary: Find the length of chord AB in a circle of radius 5 m, given central angle AOB = 1.9 radians.
accepted_alternatives: Use right-angled trigonometry: AB/2 = 5 sin 0.95, giving AB = 10 sin 0.95 = 8.13 m
Use sine rule: α = (π − 1.9)/2 = 0.6207…, AB/sin 1.9 = 5/sin 0.6207…, giving AB = 8.13 m

evidence.basis: EITHER uses the cosine rule (M1); AB² = 5² + 5² − 2×5×5×cos 1.9 (A1); OR uses right-angled trigonometry (M1); AB/2 = 5 sin 0.95 (A1); OR uses the sine rule (M1); THEN AB = 8.1341…, AB = 8.13 m (A1).

blocks.task_summary: Find the area of the shaded (larger) sector of a circle with radius 5 m and central angle 1.9 radians.
method_path: apply sector area formula: A = ½ × 5² × (2π − 1.9)
accepted_alternatives: Find area of full circle π × 5², subtract unshaded sector ½ × 5² × 1.9: A = π × 25 − ½ × 25 × 1.9 = 78.5398… − 23.75 = 54.8 m²

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: Attempt at finding reflex angle (M1); AÔB = 2π − 1.9 = 4.3831…; substitution into area formula (A1); A = ½ × 5² × 4.3831… = 54.7898… = 54.8 m² (A1). METHOD 2: A = AC − AU = π×5² − ½×5²×1.9 = 78.5398… − 23.75 = 54.7898… = 54.8 m² (M1)(A1)(A1).
